paper_info.title: Ares: An automated evaluation framework for retrieval-augmented generation systems
paper_info.authors: J Saad-Falcon, O Khattab, C Potts
paper_info.paper_abstract: Evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems traditionally relies on hand annotations for input queries, passages to re- trieve, and responses to generate. We intro- duce ARES, an Automated RAG Evaluation System, for evaluating RAG systems along the dimensions of context relevance, answer faithfulness, and answer relevance. By cre- ating its own synthetic training data, ARES finetunes lightweight LM judges to assess the quality of individual RAG components. To mitigate potential prediction errors, ARES uti- lizes a small set of human-annotated datapoints for prediction-powered inference (PPI). Across eight different knowledge-intensive tasks in KILT, SuperGLUE, and AIS, ARES accurately evaluates RAG systems while using only a few hundred human annotations during evaluation. Furthermore, ARES judges remain effective across domain shifts, proving accurate even after changing the type of queries and/or docu- ments used in the evaluated RAG systems. We make our code and datasets publicly available on Github.
paper_info.ai_abstract: 本文提出 ARES（Automated RAG Evaluation System），一种用于自动评估检索增强生成（RAG）系统的框架。ARES 从少量领域内文档、约150条人工标注的验证样本和少量问答示例出发，首先利用大语言模型生成合成数据，然后微调轻量级 DeBERTa-v3-Large 判别器，分别评估 RAG 系统在上下文相关性、答案忠实性和答案相关性三个维度的表现。为提升评估可靠性，ARES 引入预测驱动推理（PPI）方法，结合少量人工标注数据与大量模型预测结果，生成具有统计置信区间的评分。在 KILT、SuperGLUE 和 AIS 的八个知识密集型任务上的实验表明，ARES 在上下文相关性和答案相关性评估准确率上分别比现有方法 RAGAS 高出 59.3 和 14.4 个百分点，并能准确估计答案幻觉率（误差在 2.5% 以内）。此外，ARES 所需人工标注量比传统方法减少 78%，且在领域迁移后仍保持良好性能。代码和数据集已开源。

paper_info.title: Evaluation of retrieval-augmented generation: A survey
paper_info.authors: H Yu, A Gan, K Zhang, S Tong, Q Liu, Z Liu
paper_info.paper_abstract: . Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has recently gained traction in natural language processing. Numerous studies and real-world applications are leveraging its ability to enhance generative models through external informa- tion retrieval. Evaluating these RAG systems, however, poses unique challenges due to their hybrid structure and reliance on dynamic knowledge sources. To better understand these challenges, we conduct A Unified Evaluation Process of RAG (Auepora) and aim to provide a comprehensive overview of the evaluation and benchmarks of RAG systems. Specifically, we examine and compare several quantifiable metrics of the Retrieval and Generation components, such as rele- vance, accuracy, and faithfulness, within the current RAG benchmarks, encom- passing the possible output and ground truth pairs. We then analyze the various datasets and metrics, discuss the limitations of current benchmarks, and suggest potential directions to advance the field of RAG benchmarks.
paper_info.ai_abstract: 本文对检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）系统的评估方法进行了系统性综述。由于RAG结合了检索与生成两个模块，并依赖动态外部知识源，其评估面临独特挑战。作者提出了一个统一的RAG评估流程（Auepora），从“评估目标”、“数据集”和“评估指标”三个维度出发，对现有RAG评估框架进行梳理与分析。文章详细比较了针对检索模块（如相关性、召回率）、生成模块（如忠实性、准确性）以及整体系统性能的多种量化指标，总结了当前主流基准测试所使用的数据集与评价方法，并指出了现有评估体系在覆盖范围、任务适配性和动态知识处理等方面的局限性。最后，论文提出了未来RAG评估研究的改进方向，旨在推动更全面、鲁棒和实用的评估标准发展。
